none: PAS BERK-08D667: Roman coin: Radiate of Allectus
contea di ritrovamento: Oxfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy Roman radiate, probably a contemporary copy of Allectus, dating from the period AD 293-296 (Reece Period 14), PAX AVG, Pax standing left holding branch and vertical sceptre. Mint unclear, no mintmark. It is not certain that the legend is IMP C ALL, but it seems likely. Radiates of Allectus should have a mintmark of some sort, so this is probably a contemporary copy.
